subject: Decision Making
title: Mob Mentality and Deindividuation
description: A quick win: understand Mob Mentality and Deindividuation.

hook.text: In a crowd, individuals lose their sense of identity. Anonymity plus arousal creates behavior no one would do alone.

buildup.text: Philip Zimbardo showed that deindividuation makes people more aggressive, impulsive, and willing to break norms.

discovery.text: Uniforms, masks, and large groups all increase deindividuation.

twist.text: Online anonymity creates the same effect. Trolling, doxxing, and pile-ons are deindividuation in digital form.

climax.text: Crowd wisdom requires independence. Mob mentality destroys it.

punchline.text: Mob Mentality and Deindividuation: good judgment beats certainty every time.

quiz.question: What causes mob mentality?
options: Deindividuation — anonymity and arousal make people lose their sense of personal identity
